checks.name: Authored anchors are finite, normalized, distinct, and meaningfully separated
Client-to-board mapping preserves location under translation and resize
Forge accepts the matching destination and rejects loose, wrong, and distant drops
Forge fails closed for invalid indices, coordinates, and board dimensions
Own uses a physical circle at every tested board aspect ratio
Own fails closed for non-finite input and collapsed board dimensions
Fleet recognizes intentional upward flicks and longer deliberate sweeps
Fleet rejects clicks, short or wrong-way travel, and invalid timing
Training seed is three Unicode code points of inert text with controls excluded
All four gate fields expose bounded finite non-collapsed affine instances and particles
Gate field instance and particle fixtures are seeded deterministically
Gate visual systems retain shared clock, grade, and contextual palette ownership

limitations: Pure math and source checks do not establish actual pointer capture, cursor tracking, cancellation, keyboard/touch parity, animation settlement, GPU appearance, or emotional quality.
Replay, duplicate action guards, lifecycle cleanup, shared native callback count, reduced-motion behavior, and locked Merge timing require separate browser evidence.
No GPU presented FPS or physical mobile acceptance is inferred. Training and fleet remain local demonstrations, not executed code or external agents.
